en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a tall medieval stone clock tower with crenellations at the top and large clock faces on two sides. The tower rises behind a multi‑windowed historic building with an ornate entrance and balcony. A streetlamp, bare trees, and a few small figures are visible in the foreground. Handwritten-style text at the bottom identifies the location.
